supersessionReason: Calibration of overly permissive scoring criteria, capital-inventory conflation, limited-capital bias, and duplicate scoring evidence.

owns: deployment quality of selections actually held

rules.5: multiple exceptional deployment signals with no contradiction; never triggered by pick count, round count, one first-round pick, acquired status, or full four-round participation alone
rules.4: clearly strong use of the actual capital set with positive sequencing or capital-quality evidence
rules.2: meaningful structural deployment concern inside the available capital set
rules.1: major structural misuse or verified integrity failure

rules.5: multiple exceptional context alignments across meaningful capital decisions with no major mismatch
rules.4: clear positive alignment supported by meaningful roster-context evidence
rules.3: reasonable interaction with entering roster context
rules.2: clear mismatch between allocation and meaningful context

rules.5: unusually strong construction relative to available capital with multiple signals

excludes: position diversity as a standalone positive

rules.5: exceptionally balanced use of capital with multiple signals and no contradiction
exceptional structural breadth given available capital with multiple signals

interactionRules: Shared evidence may appear in narrative but earns primary scoring credit once.
Roster Context interprets thin/deep interaction; Concentration records structural share without fully repeating the contextual reward or penalty.
Draft Construction does not score simple position diversity; Optionality owns positional breadth.
Capital inventory never earns deployment points by itself.
Missing 2021 Roster Context is excluded and weights are renormalized; no neutral substitute is used.

immutability.correctionPolicy: new version only; never overwrite approved original
